all_BLAST_barcodes_taxonomy_lca <- all_BLAST_barcodes %>%
  group_by(qseqid) %>%
  mutate(lca = {
    agreed <- sapply(tax_cols_present, 
                     function(col) {
      vals <- unique(na.omit(get(col)))
      if (length(vals) == 1)
        vals
      else
        NA_character_
    })
    lca <- tail(agreed[!is.na(agreed)], 1)
    if (length(lca) == 0)
      NA_character_
    else
      as.character(lca)
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(matching_rank = {
    tax_values <- c(domain, 
                    phylum, 
                    class, 
                    order, 
                    family, 
                    genus, 
                    species)
    rank_names <- c("domain",
                    "phylum",
                    "class",
                    "order",
                    "family",
                    "genus",
                    "species")
    match_idx <- which(!is.na(tax_values) & 
                         tax_values == lca)
    if (length(match_idx) > 0)
      rank_names[match_idx[1]]
    else
      NA_character_
  }) #%>%
